name: color-spec-sheet
description: Generates a Pantone-style color specification sheet from any uploaded product or character design image. The output is a pixel-perfect 3300×1350px PNG that mirrors a measured reference template, with color swatches, PMS C codes, finish labels, deco group boxes, leader lines, and a companion PMS table. No AI image model is ever used — the uploaded image is placed unchanged via Python/PIL. Trigger this skill whenever a user says "color spec", "color extraction", "PMS sheet", "Pantone spec", "extra
author: Official
